# Vetta 0.6.28
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-26 -->

## English

### New

- The sidebar has View settings: show project sessions and chats together in one flat list, and sort by reply time or creation time; pinned sessions stay on top. Thanks to @Tumicc (openvetta/open-vetta#90).
- When you update across several versions, the update dialog shows what changed in each one: the newest in full, earlier versions folded, and a link to the full release history.

### Improvements

- The What's New dialog has a new banner illustration.

### Fixes

- After you change the chat model in Claw settings, existing WeChat, Feishu and other chats switch to the new model right away, with no need to start a new chat.

## 中文

### 新增

- 侧栏新增视图设置：可把项目会话与对话平铺在同一列表，按回复时间或创建时间排序，置顶会话始终在最上面。感谢 @Tumicc（openvetta/open-vetta#90）。
- 跨多个版本更新时，更新弹窗会列出每一版的改动：最新一版直接展示，较早的版本折叠可展开，末尾可查看全部更新记录。

### 改进

- 版本介绍弹窗换上了新的横幅插画。

### 修复

- 在 Claw 设置里更换对话模型后，已有的微信、飞书等对话会立即改用新模型，不必再开新对话。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.27...v0.6.28
